name: ChartPNG: Google Sheets chart to Telegram

parameters.content:
**ChartPNG: Google Sheets chart to Telegram**

Sheet setup: a tab called Data with the headers label and value.

1. Pick your Google Sheets credential, your spreadsheet and the Data tab in "Read rows".
2. In "Send photo to Telegram", pick your Telegram credential and set the Chat ID.
3. Run the workflow once, then publish it (Active on n8n 1.x).

Telegram gets the chart as a URL in the Photo field, so no file is uploaded and no binary data is passed. The "Check the render" node opens the URL once, so a bad sheet stops the run before a broken link is sent.

Optional: enable "Post to Slack" and pick your Slack credential to send the same URL as a Slack image block. A Slack image URL can be at most 3000 characters; over that, the Slack node stops with a message and Telegram is not affected.

This URL is unsigned, so the image keeps the small watermark. A signed URL (see Docs, Signed URLs) removes it: https://chartpng.dev/docs#signed-urls

Docs: https://chartpng.dev/guides/google-sheets-chart-to-telegram

parameters.blocksUi: ={{ (() => { const j = $('Build chart URL').first().json; if (j.slackError) throw new Error(j.slackError); return JSON.stringify({ blocks: j.blocks }); })() }}
